project.description: Your repo, but make it a girl — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page, driven by your coding agent.

brand.artStyle: Museum white cube — a minimalist gallery that hangs real pipeline deliverables as framed exhibits: white walls, thin dark frames, spotlight ellipses under each work, generous negative space and curator-style caption typography (serif titles, sans metadata, mono order ids). Restraint everywhere; the character appears only once, in the lobby portrait.
